cases.name: refused
cases.description: The speech service refused the job: a key it won't take, a model the account hasn't turned on, a quota it says is gone (an HTTP 403).

cases.name: busy
cases.description: The speech service is busy or rate-limited: too many sessions at once, the quota used up, a 429 or 5xx.

cases.name: unreachable
cases.description: The service can't be reached (the hub machine's network), or no job opens (the contribution isn't running, no ready in time).

cases.name: no_upstream
cases.description: The extension has no upstream set up: no job can be opened, read as out of reach.

cases.name: bad_frame
cases.description: The extension couldn't read a frame: not about the upstream, read as failed.

cases.name: unknown_extension_code
cases.description: A code from a newer extension: the set is open, so it reads as failed.

cases.name: unknown_problem
cases.description: A problem from a newer hub: the phone says the hub isn't transcribing, without a reason.

cases.name: no_interim
cases.description: Lines go on without captions: no fallback, no reason.
